dz: 弗朗西斯·德雷克爵士带着一支英军攻克并占领了西班牙殖民港口卡塔赫纳德印地安斯两个月,获得了赎金和战利品.
de: Sir Francis Drake with an English force captures and occupies the Spanish colonial port of Cartagena de Indias for two months, obtaining a ransom and booty.

t: 由佩德罗·萨米恩托·德·甘博阿(Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa)所领导的海…
te: A naval expedition led by Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa founds Nombre de Jesús, the first of two short-lived Spanish settle…
dz: 由佩德罗·萨米恩托·德·甘博阿(Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa)所领导的海军远征队发现了诺姆布雷·德·耶苏斯(Normbre de Jesús),这是麦哲伦海峡上两个短暂的西班牙定居点中的第一个.
de: A naval expedition led by Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa founds Nombre de Jesús, the first of two short-lived Spanish settlements in the Strait of Magellan.

t: 在坎特伯雷召集会上,由坎特伯雷省上院所组成的天主教主教们同意以亨利八世为英国教会的最高领袖和神…
te: At the Convocation of Canterbury, the Catholic bishops comprising the Upper House of the Province of Canterbury agree t…
dz: 在坎特伯雷召集会上,由坎特伯雷省上院所组成的天主教主教们同意以亨利八世为英国教会的最高领袖和神职人员作风格"只要基督之法允许".
de: At the Convocation of Canterbury, the Catholic bishops comprising the Upper House of the Province of Canterbury agree to style Henry VIII supreme head of the English church and clergy "so far as the law of Christ allows".

t: 切斯特的罗伯特完成了他从阿拉伯语到拉丁语的翻译"Liber de compacte alche…
te: Robert of Chester completes his translation from Arabic to Latin of the Liber de compositione alchemiae, marking the bi…
dz: 切斯特的罗伯特完成了他从阿拉伯语到拉丁语的翻译"Liber de compacte alchemiae",标志着西方炼金术的诞生.
de: Robert of Chester completes his translation from Arabic to Latin of the Liber de compositione alchemiae, marking the birth of Western alchemy.

t: 朝廷官员郭威领导了军事政变,并宣布自己为"后周"的皇帝.
te: Guo Wei, a court official, leads a military coup and declares himself emperor of the new Later Zhou.
dz: 朝廷官员郭威领导了军事政变,并宣布自己为"后周"的皇帝.
de: Guo Wei, a court official, leads a military coup and declares himself emperor of the new Later Zhou.

te: The death under mysterious circumstances of Tiberius Claudius Caesar Britannicus, heir to the Roman Empire, on the eve …
dz: 罗马帝国继承人Tiberius Claudius Caesar Britannicus在神秘情况下的死亡,在他到来的年龄前夕为尼禄成为皇帝扫清了道路.
de: The death under mysterious circumstances of Tiberius Claudius Caesar Britannicus, heir to the Roman Empire, on the eve of his coming of age clears the way for Nero to become Emperor.

de: Traditional date for the foundation of Japan by Emperor Jimmu.
